name: Paracas and Huacachina
tagline: Sea lions on Ballestas and a desert oasis
summary: Paracas is a desert peninsula on Peru's south coast. Take a boat to the Ballestas Islands, "the poor man's Galápagos", full of sea lions, penguins and seabirds, past the mysterious Candelabra geoglyph. Explore the red-sand beaches of the national reserve, then ride dune buggies and sandboard at the Huacachina oasis.
seasonNote: Sunny most of the year; winds pick up in the afternoon.
arrival: About 4 hours by bus from Lima.
gettingAround: Tours; taxis between Paracas, Ica and Huacachina (1 hour).
cashTip: Carry soles for taxis and small places; cards work in hotels. Tip about 10 percent.
foodTip: Ceviche, Ica pisco and tejas sweets.
